A real lazy-load address wins over an inline data src when the payload is not kept

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" data-src=\"https://example.com/real.png\" alt=\"icon\"></p>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("inline_data_media" = "drop_element"), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result$content)
```
